title: Guided Map Maker Navigation, Rainbow in the Dark UI, and Embedded Help
selected_by_owner: After reviewing actual Android Chrome screenshots of MMHT-11 and MMHT-15, owner explicitly directed a standalone Map Maker UI/UX overhaul: specialist spatial controls must no longer stay permanently open, map-type navigation must be obvious, features individually hideable, Dark Rainbow/Rainbow in the Dark skin applied, and plain-language help provided for every specialty (2026-11-20).

in_scope: Retain cumulative MMHT-15 tester and all earlier map authoring workbenches and IDs, while replacing stacked specialty bars with a canvas-first four-section map navigation shell.

Offer eight owner-understandable document starters (four core modes and four interior-specialized ship/vehicle/base types), 27 discoverable tool actions and 26 searchable how-to topics including a plain-language non-Euclidean topology glossary.
Make editor and panel visibility deliberately selectable, mirror live geometry/topology/GM/grid/fog/water preview switches and expose the original layer/feature manager and inspector on demand.
Apply the canonical UISK-11 Rainbow in the Dark foundation/spectrum hex tokens with restrained semantic accent allocation, accessible focus and responsive compact touch controls.
Supply complete standalone HTML, offline user manual, previous editable examples, development/test scripts, browser screenshot previews, sha256 checksums and verification report.
boundaries: This is owner-selected remediation of completed standalone HTML prototype, not automatic MMHT-16 or a Unity product implementation lane.
No gameplay execution, physical movement, portal transition, mining/farming/ecology calculation, cross-tester linking, authoring data schema rewrite or canonical permission change.
Toggle operations control presentational visibility only; GM/player filtered reference exports are not production authorization.
Automated Chromium desktop/mobile viewport runs do not establish physical Android content:// file-open compatibility, installed app acceptance, external persistence or owner review acceptance.

evidence.prior_examples: Twenty JSON companion artifacts copied into standalone package from original MMHT-15 package without modifying records.
evidence.validation: Node --check passed on added JS and assembled standalone. Chromium Playwright set_content at 1366x900 and 390x844: zero page errors or document horizontal overflow, no default stacked spatial bars. Mobile canvas top shifted from ~601px to ~516px after compacting toolbar and floor options. Successful navigation, eight map-type starter creates producing independent valid document IDs/modes, help searching/topology glossary and editor deep links, original layer/inspector access, overlay toggle with restoration, Escape closing the drawer and existing sample integrity (four MMHT-15 examples documentError null). Existing prior-cycle test API objects remained available. ZIP checksum verified, archive integrity passed with 40 files. No physical Android file-open test or Unity execution.

next_action: Owner opens UX-01 standalone HTML on actual Android Chrome and desktop, reviews navigation/tool discovery and spatial help, and reports remaining usability issues. No automatic new tester cycle is selected.
successor_rule: Further map-tool redesign, consolidation or gameplay integration requires separate owner direction.

last_material_progress.evidence: MMHT-UX-01 cumulative standalone browser artifact, Rainbow in the Dark tokenized navigation, 27 tools/26 guides, 8 starters, 40-file ZIP and Chromium desktop/mobile tests.

stop_reason.evidence: Bounded owner-selected HTML UI repair delivered and browser-validated with complete portable documentation; actual Android owner review and installed-app integration remain explicitly outstanding.
